rationale: Per protocol §4 INSTRUCTIONS are ground truth (name 'prayer' but description is one-knee-reach-forward pose; matches worker-D-batch4 name-description mismatch pattern). (1) LEFT knee down (kneeling): leftHip 80→0 (thigh vertical, knee below hip), leftKnee 100→110 (deep flexion, shin trailing back), leftAnkle added=0. (2) RIGHT leg forward (lunge-style for balance): rightHip 80→60 (thigh forward), rightKnee 100→90 (right-angle), rightAnkle added=0. (3) RIGHT arm extended forward (opposite to left kneeling leg): rightShoulder -12→0 (no abduction, sagittal plane), shoulderFwdR -10→-90 (dramatic forward reach per corrected - = forward), rightElbow 100→20 (nearly straight, extended). (4) LEFT arm natural at side: leftShoulder added=0, shoulderFwdL -12→0, leftElbow 100→30 (slight bend). (5) Torso diagonal: spine 18→25 (deeper forward to 'follow reach'), globalTwist added=-10 (rotate torso toward figure's right where right arm reaches; per convention + = rotate left, so - = right). (6) neck 14→0 (no side tilt). Significant reconstruction; confidence 0.6 due to rig-limited kneeling approximation and inability to do true diagonal torso (no lateral flexion joint).
